description: Returns the outcome of sending a project checked with start_part_check to Fillio: the request carries the confirmation returned by get_submission_summary and the same answers; Fillio receives the request like a submission made in the portal, and the user an acknowledgement by email. If the project or the answers have changed since the summary, the submission is refused. Without a confirmation, only that summary is returned, and nothing is sent or saved. An answer left out takes the one already entered in the portal, if any. Useful when the user has decided to send their part for a quote. Requires the same connected Fillio account.

annual_volume.description: Expected annual volume in production; a range or “to be determined” are answers.

confirmation.description: Confirmation returned by get_submission_summary; without it, only the summary is returned and nothing is sent.

project.description: Number of the checked project to send (DEM-…).

quantity.description: First-batch quantity, prototypes included; a range is an answer.

resin.description: Overmolding resin: polyamide, urethane, silicone or advise (Fillio's choice). Defaults to the one of the check.

supply.description: Who supplies the components to overmold (cable, connectors, board): client (the user supplies them), fillio (Fillio sources them), mixed or unknown (to be discussed).

target_date.description: Target date for the first parts: a date, a month, “as soon as possible” or “to be determined”.

name: submit_part_check
title: Submission of a checked project
